mapper.select: SELECT id, role_code, role_name, role_scope, description, enabled, system_role, revision FROM payment_admin_role WHERE id = #{roleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT permission_code FROM payment_admin_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_code

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, NULL AS merchant_id, NULL AS merchant_name, b.enabled FROM payment_admin_user_role b JOIN payment_admin_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.role_id = #{roleId} UNION ALL SELECT u.id, u.username, m.id, m.display_name, b.enabled FROM payment_admin_user_merchant_role b JOIN payment_admin_user u ON u.id = b.user_id JOIN payment_merchant m ON m.id = b.merchant_id WHERE b.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY username, merchant_id

SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_scope, NULL AS merchant_id, NULL AS merchant_name, b.enabled, r.enabled AS role_enabled FROM payment_admin_user_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_scope, m.id, m.display_name, b.enabled, r.enabled FROM payment_admin_user_merchant_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id JOIN payment_merchant m ON m.id = b.merchant_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_scope, merchant_name, role_name

SELECT CONCAT('ROLE_', r.role_code) FROM payment_admin_user_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.enabled AND r.enabled UNION SELECT CONCAT('AUTHZ_PLATFORM_', r.id, '_', r.revision) FROM payment_admin_user_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.enabled AND r.enabled UNION SELECT CONCAT('AUTHZ_MERCHANT_', b.merchant_id, '_', r.id, '_', r.revision) FROM payment_admin_user_merchant_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.enabled AND r.enabled UNION SELECT p.permission_code FROM payment_admin_user_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id JOIN payment_admin_role_permission p ON p.role_id = r.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.enabled AND r.enabled UNION SELECT p.permission_code FROM payment_admin_user_merchant_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id JOIN payment_admin_role_permission p ON p.role_id = r.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.enabled AND r.enabled

SELECT DISTINCT b.merchant_id FROM payment_admin_user_merchant_role b JOIN payment_admin_role r ON r.id = b.role_id JOIN payment_admin_role_permission p ON p.role_id = r.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.enabled AND r.enabled AND p.permission_code = #{permission}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_admin_user_role (user_id, role_id, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{enabled}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM payment_admin_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_admin_user_merchant_role (user_id, merchant_id, role_id, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{roleId}, #{enabled}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, merchant_id, role_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM payment_admin_user_merchant_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
